evals.prompt: My how-to video about resizing images in Photoshop isn't getting any views even though I think it's genuinely useful.
evals.expected_output: Should identify this as a search-intent video and recommend a keyword-forward title matching how people actually search, plus a description with the primary keyword phrase in the first sentence. Should note thumbnail clarity matters more than intrigue for search-intent content. Should suggest checking what's currently ranking for that query.
assertions: Distinguishes search-intent thumbnail approach from browse/suggested approach

evals.prompt: Give me 3 thumbnail concepts for a video titled 'I Tried Cold Plunging for 30 Days'.
evals.expected_output: Should propose 3 distinct thumbnail concepts with a clear single focal point each (e.g., a reaction face mid-plunge, a before/after split, a day-counter graphic), each readable at small size with minimal text, and each thumbnail text differing from the video title rather than repeating it.
assertions: Each has one clear focal point
